title: rhinanthus major subsp. serotinus
intro: Rhinanthus major subsp. serotinus, commonly known as Early Summer-Rose Gentian, is a flowering plant species within the family Orobanchaceae. It is a hemiparasitic plant that derives some of its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants, typically grasses. The Early Summer-Rose Gentian is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Rhinanthus major subsp. serotinus include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, hepatoprotective, and immunomodulatory effects.
